result:
I would change the world so that every person, from the moment they are born, has unconditional access to the resources they need to thrive—food, shelter, healthcare, education, safety, and the freedom to pursue their passions without fear or oppression. We would rewrite the systems that dictate who gets to prosper and who doesn’t, ensuring that no one is born into scarcity or exclusion because of where they are from, the color of their skin, their gender, their abilities, or the circumstances they were dealt at birth. The world would operate on the principle: *What if we treated each other, and the planet, as if we were all part of the same living system?*

I’d also dismantle the myth that growth and progress must come at the cost of the earth or the well-being of others. Instead, we’d align our economies, policies, and daily lives with the regeneration of ecosystems and the deep care of all living beings—humans, animals, plants, and the land itself—because we are all connected, and no one thrives unless we all do.

Most importantly, I’d make sure that power—political, economic, cultural—is decentralized and held by communities who can hold it accountable to those most harmed by past systems. Fear and scarcity would no longer be used to control people. Instead, trust, collaboration, and curiosity would be the driving forces of how we organize ourselves.

In short: *a world where love—not fear, not greed, not domination—determines how we share resources, how we solve conflicts, and how we care for one another and the planet.*
